== Stats ==
:[[Blunt damage]]: 19-35 (Requires 9 [[Hammer Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while in a [[stance]])
:[[Health]] +30
:Lengthens [[Deep Wound]] duration on foes by 33%

==Skin== 
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[War Hammer (spiked)]].
